title: Trade Flows In Flux
summary: Do changes in trade flows impact the tanker market? For today's weekly opinion we decided to take a look at almost 5 years of crude oil trade data (2014 - 2018) to see if we can discern any interesting trends or developments. Are certain segments growing faster than others?
